_schema.description: Published Legislative Council voting intention by region, entered by hand from the pollster's release. Seeds the upper-house quota calculator (upper.html). Newest poll first; the calculator uses the first one that covers the region.

fields.start_date: Fieldwork start, YYYY-MM-DD (first of the month when only months are published)
fields.end_date: Fieldwork end, YYYY-MM-DD (last of the month when only months are published)
fields.regions: Region id (regions.json) -> {party code: primary vote %}. OTH is the pollster's combined 'Ind/Others' figure, several small parties together, not one party

polls.notes: About 340 electors per country region and 370 per metropolitan region, so each regional figure has a margin of error of roughly ±5 points. Figures from the region tables in the release.
